hints.title: Repeated Prefix Criterion
hints.text: A valid prefix deletion of length L requires s[i..i+L-1] to match s[i+L..i+2*L-1].

hints.title: Longest Common Prefix Table
hints.text: Precompute the longest common prefix lcp[i][j] for all suffix pairs (i, j) in O(n^2) backward dynamic programming.

hints.title: Maximum Deletion DP
hints.text: Define dp[i] as the maximum deletions on suffix s[i..]. If lcp[i][i + L] >= L, transition to dp[i] = max(dp[i], 1 + dp[i + L]).

hints.title: LCP Table and Suffix Dynamic Programming Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputing LCP array takes O(n^2), followed by O(n^2) suffix transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated string slicing and substring comparisons take O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: LCP table memoizes substring matches for instant condition checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes suffix common prefixes to transition dynamic programming states in O(n^2).
